choices.why: A modern dark walnut desk on slim black hairpin legs, 120 cm wide, that fits neatly under the small window and matches the black-and-dark-wood palette.

A matte black lamp with a small wood accent and a USB port, which ties into the desk while staying in the sober palette.
A compact black leather armchair on dark wood legs that fits the corner by the tall window and stays within the black, dark wood and gray palette.

answer.why: Every piece repeats the same mix of black metal or leather and dark wood, which reads modern and sober against the white walls and the dark floor.
